subject: C_to_N

delays_ms.note: trigger is a native lower bound read before the request, so trigger-based delays are upper bounds of the true request delay

reference_at_takeover.mechanism: RAPTOR internal capture (current position and yaw, current horizontal velocity, then fixed deceleration; P4-01c T1)

primary.max_altitude_loss_definition: max over [trigger, window end] of descent below the altitude at the trigger

observation_quality.alignment: backward as-of only; fresh sample after source gap restarts continuity

primary.window_constraints_note: Window = [trigger, end of post_event phase]. Safety envelope plus P0 hover error/tilt limits applied to the active controller target; unchanged p0.json thresholds.

saturation_definition.note: actuator_motors control in [0,1]; upper/lower limit within 1e-3

curves.note: every 5th local-position sample for figures; time relative to the actual change

problems: takeover target parameters at trigger {'MC_RAPTOR_RTGT': 1, 'MC_RAPTOR_RTDEC': None} != planned
teacher-forced previous action differs from classic applied motors

treatment_parameters.description: N2 memory; speed-matched takeover target: activation capture of the current position and yaw with the current horizontal velocity (vertical 0), then a fixed 2.0 m/s^2 deceleration along that direction to zero, target position integrated from the target velocity, then hold at the end point (MC_RAPTOR_RTGT=1, MC_RAPTOR_RTDEC=2.0)

problems: teacher-forced previous action differs from classic applied motors

criteria.safety_envelope: any of tilt >= 45 deg, angular-rate component >= 8 rad/s, horizontal radius >= 10 m, altitude >= 8 m (frozen safety envelope; reaching the limit counts), or a runner safety abort
criteria.no_joint_recovery: joint recovery not SETTLED within 10 s after the actual change (frozen P0 thresholds, active controller target)
criteria.motor_saturation: any motor at >=0.999 or <=0.001 continuously for at least 0.5 s inside [trigger, window end]
